question: Who was awarded the Vigyan Ratna - 2024 for contributions in the field of Biological Sciences?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prof. Govindarajan Padmanabhan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prof. Govindarajan Padmanabhan** is a renowned Indian biochemist and academician.
 
• He has made significant contributions to the field of **molecular biology** and **biotechnology**.
 
• Prof. Padmanabhan is known for his research on **malarial parasite metabolism** and the **development of recombinant vaccines**.
 
• He has been associated with the **Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bangalore**, where he has served in various capacities including **Director**.
 
• He is a recipient of several prestigious awards including the **Padma Shri** and the **Padma Bhushan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dr. Aditi Sen De**__

 __
 
• **Dr. Aditi Sen De** is a prominent Indian physicist.
 
• She is known for her work in the field of **quantum information and computation.**
 
• She is associated with the **Harish-Chandra Research Institute (HRI), Allahabad.**
 
 
 
• **Dr. Swati Nayak**__
 __
 
• **Dr. Swati Nayak** is an agricultural scientist known for her work in **rice research and development.**
 
• She works with the **International Rice Research Institute (IRRI).**
 
 
 
• **Dr. Ramesh Sharma**__
 
 
• **Dr. Ramesh Sharma** is a noted Indian oncologist.
 
• He has contributed significantly to the field of **cancer research and treatment.**
